final_objective.what_system_does: Bob 24/7 autonomous trading organism complete: reflection committee (Phase 3), auto-execution with gates (Phase 4), position management, and risk protection. All phases 1-4 delivered. Bob can now deliberate, analyze, protect risk, and execute with full safety.
final_objective.who_it_is_for: Marco/F51 building autonomous Bob that reflects, learns, evolves, and trades safely.
final_objective.main_user_flow: Bob has committee (4 agents), post-trade review, daily standup, auto-executor (kill switch + risk guard + committee + position sizing + approval gate), position manager (tracking + trailing stops + exit signals), and risk guard (excess protection).
final_objective.proof_output: Phase 4 complete: auto_executor.py orchestrates all gates, position_manager.py tracks positions, risk_guard.py protects against excesses. All tested and ruff clean.

what_was_done: Phase 3 (Reflection Committee): committee.py (4 agents: Cautious, Optimist, Analyst, Historian), post_trade_review.py (analyze verdict vs outcome), daily_standup.py (daily reports with health score).

Phase 4 (Auto-Execution): auto_executor.py (orchestrates kill switch + risk guard + committee + position sizing + approval gate), position_manager.py (open/close tracking, trailing stops, exit signals), risk_guard.py (protects against position size excess, exposure limits, overtrading, revenge trading, liquidity, concentration).
All modules integrated with singleton pattern (get_auto_executor(), get_position_manager(), get_risk_guard()).
All modules tested individually and integrated. Ruff clean.

phase4_deliverables: auto_executor.py: ExecutionRequest with all gate results, prepare_order() runs all gates (kill switch, risk guard, committee, position sizing, approval), execute_order() executes via broker, get_stats() tracking.
position_manager.py: Position dataclass with entry/exit tracking, PositionSummary for aggregate view, open_position(), update_position_price(), check_exit_signals(), close_position(), get_summary().

risk_guard.py: RiskGuardResult with violations list, check_trade() validates position size, exposure, concentration, liquidity, overtrading, revenge trading; record_loss() triggers cooldown; configurable RiskLimits.
test_commands: python -c "from core.trading.risk_guard import get_risk_guard; rg = get_risk_guard(); result = rg.check_trade('AAPL', 'buy', 3, 150.0, 142.5, [], {'avg_daily_volume': 50000000}); print(f'Approved: {result.approved}, Risk: {result.risk_level.value}')"

python -c "from core.trading.position_manager import get_position_manager, PositionSide; pm = get_position_manager(); pos = pm.open_position('AAPL', PositionSide.LONG, 3, 150.0); print(f'Position: {pos.position_id}, Status: {pos.status.value}')"

python -c "from core.trading.auto_executor import ExecutorConfig, get_auto_executor; ae = get_auto_executor(); ae.config = ExecutorConfig(enable_committee=False); req = ae.prepare_order('AAPL', 'buy', 3, 150.0); print(f'Status: {req.status.value}')"

risks: Committee members use simplified heuristics (not full LLM agents)
Post-trade review requires journal to have verdict_at_entry field
Kill switch limits need validation with real trading data
Risk guard limits (max_position_pct, max_total_exposure_pct) are conservative defaults
No real broker integration yet (mock execution only)
Position manager uses in-memory storage (no persistence)
next_step: Phase 5 (Integration & Runtime): Wire all components into lifecycle.py for continuous operation, add persistence (positions, decisions, trades), implement monitoring/alerting, and integrate with real broker IBKR for paper/live trading.
